title: Pickleball Match Footage Splicer
desc: A command-line tool that uses a YOLOv10 object-detection model to automatically identify rally segments in pickleball match footage and cut out the dead time between points. Built in Python with a TypeScript-based CLI layer and packaged with Docker for reproducible, one-command video processing. Designed to save players and coaches hours of manual film review by turning a full match recording into a tight reel of active play.

title: PGSG Grant Management Platform
desc: Full-stack grant management platform built for Purdue Graduate Student Government to run the entire grant application lifecycle end-to-end. The FastAPI/Python backend enforces double-blind reviewer assignment and a multi-stage approval pipeline, while PostgreSQL stores applications, awards, and reimbursement records. A React/TypeScript frontend gives applicants, reviewers, and admins dedicated dashboards, with Keycloak handling role-based access control so each group only sees what it's permitted to.

title: Site Scouter
desc: Geospatial decision-support tool built at Catapult 2026 that helps identify optimal sites for solar panels, wind turbines, and data centers within a user-drawn region. A FastAPI backend subdivides the area into cells and scores each one using satellite imagery, terrain, and OpenStreetMap data, including a PyTorch model trained on thousands of real wind and solar projects that predicts power generation with R² > 0.90. The React + Leaflet frontend ranks and visualizes the top candidate sites on an interactive map, aiming to give companies and affected communities clearer, data-driven siting decisions.

title: Roadie Rescue
desc: 3rd-place project at Purdue's Hello World Hackathon 2024 — a community-driven roadside assistance app that lets stranded drivers share their exact location and issue so nearby volunteers can help. Built on the MERN stack, with a Node/Express REST API backed by MongoDB and a React frontend that uses Leaflet for real-time map visualization, geolocation pinpointing, and routing between drivers and responders. Also includes a self-service troubleshooting guide for common roadside issues.

title: Save The Chicken
desc: A quick reflex-testing arcade game built in Unity where players must react in time to halt Santa's sleigh before a chicken crosses the road. Built in C# using Unity's physics and animation systems, with the game exported to WebGL and playable directly in-browser via GitHub Pages.

title: Hexagon World
desc: Procedural world-building simulation built in Unity that generates explorable terrain on a hexagonal grid system, inspired by strategy-game map generation. Written primarily in C# using Unity's engine and component system, with the interactive build exported to WebGL and hosted directly on GitHub Pages for anyone to try in-browser.

title: Talking Slides
desc: BoilerMake 2025 hackathon project that converts uploaded PDF study materials into podcast-style audio so students can study hands-free. A Django REST Framework backend extracts text with PyMuPDF, generates a script, and synthesizes multi-voice narration through the OpenAI API, with MongoDB/GridFS storing documents and Redis caching results for fast playback. The React frontend, secured with Auth0, lets students stream the generated podcast in-browser or download it for offline listening.

title: Bucket List
desc: Mobile social app that lets friend groups create, share, and check off bucket-list goals together. Built with a Node.js backend and a React Native frontend in JavaScript, it gives users a native mobile experience for tracking shared goals and celebrating completions with friends. Developed as a Purdue ACM SIGAPP team project.

title: BoilerBuzz
desc: Cross-platform mobile social app that helps Purdue students discover campus events and clubs through shareable posters. The Express/TypeScript backend exposes a documented REST API (Swagger/OpenAPI) backed by PostgreSQL for posters, clubs, users, bookmarks, and search, while the Expo React Native frontend consumes that API on iOS, Android, and web with Clerk handling authentication. Built as a Purdue ACM SIGAPP team project with full CRUD, tag-based search, and role-based club administration.

title: BoilerGram
desc: Instagram-inspired social media platform built from scratch in Java for a CS 180 team project, using a custom multi-threaded client-server architecture over raw TCP sockets instead of a web framework. The Swing-based GUI client supports account creation, following/blocking, and profile browsing, while the server manages authentication, persistence, and real-time group messaging with file-based storage. Unit tested with JUnit and built around clean interface-based design with custom exception handling.

title: Boiler Rooms — Backend
desc: Backend API for a Purdue housing app that lets students view, rate, and review off-campus dorms and apartments on an interactive map. Built with ASP.NET Core 6 and MongoDB, it uses custom scope-based authorization handlers to secure endpoints and organizes logic across dedicated controller, service, and entity layers. Containerized with Docker and deployed via GitHub Actions CI/CD as part of a Purdue ACM SIGAPP team project.
